name: Hello 3D (Shenzhen Hello 3D Technology Co., Ltd.)
summary: Shenzhen filament producer that self-describes as an OEM/ODM manufacturer with its own brand, claiming a 5,000 m2 factory, four lines and about 1,000 t/yr. It sells a broad range (PLA, silk, marble, colour-change, glow, conductive PLA, ABS, PETG, TPU, PVA) mainly through Alibaba and other marketplaces, with a thin Amazon presence. No relationship to any catalog company was found.

product_lines.name: Glow in the Dark Multicolor Rainbow PLA
product_lines.notes: The only Amazon listing on the deal tracker, $14.99/kg.

additional_notes: USPTO HELLO3D mark (serial 97201090, filed 2022-01-04, registered 2023-01-31) is owned by Shenzhen Hello 3D Technology Co., Ltd., consistent with the factory profiles. Factory size and output figures are self-reported on Alibaba/Made-in-China. No official brand website found. A possible link to RepRapper appeared only as a search co-hit: rumoured, uncorroborated. Its OEM/ODM clients are not named, so no manufactures-for item is recorded.

provenance.conflicts: Factory capacity, lines and OEM/ODM role are self-reported and unverified. The Justia owner page returned 403 (snippet only).
